name: Toyosu
tagline: Tokyo in 16 minutes and Otemachi in 17 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Koto City, where Tokyo Metro and Yurikamome run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 17 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 27 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 2.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 2.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.4 m to 5.9 m, a difference of 4.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 5 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: フードストアあおき 東京豊洲店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 昭和医科大学江東豊洲病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 青藍会鈴木病院, about 21 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and Yurikamome. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and Yurikamome runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. Yurikamome runs at 92%. Its busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥270,000 to ¥280,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Toyosu, but Shin-Toyosu is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Toyosu. Shin-Toyosu has only the Yurikamome, so Toyosu is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Shin-Toyosu takes 8 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥57,000 more at Shin-Toyosu. On quiet, though, Shin-Toyosu comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Toyosu, but Shijo-Mae is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Toyosu in a straight line. Shijo-Mae has only the Yurikamome, so Toyosu is the better connected. To Shinjuku, for instance, Shijo-Mae takes 10 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥49,000 more at Shijo-Mae. On quiet, though, Shijo-Mae comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
noiseSources: 豊洲有明線 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
晴海通り (4 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
